title: It’s not a mall, it’s some kind of city for me
content: But I joined this sub after reading it for multiple days and recognizing the same kind of phenomenon I have tried to describe to my wife. My recurring dreamworld is a mostly urban space, a huge gray city that has huge architecture that seems to throb with life tho I usually don’t recall seeing other people. The largest feature is a gigantic building that is art deco style with big sweeping curves and perfectly symmetrical. There is a main thoroughfare that has many lanes that runs straight from the harbor/waters edge into and through this building and into the city beyond. The thruway is my favorite part of this because I wish our cities were like this. The center lanes are fast electric trains that only stop at main points like the harbor and the inside of this building — there are giant loading and unloading platforms inside the building at the level of the thoroughfare, which is something like 5-6 floors above the street—and other places where other train lines branch off. On either side of the fast line are local electric trains that stop every few blocks. Outside of those are busways where electric buses roll at fast speeds for the city because they are the only traffic. They move so smoothly and regularly spaced that I think they are driverless automated buses. The buses stop regularly too but not as frequently as the local trains, and there are busways that curve off and away from the main thoroughfare that go out to the community on either side of the thruway. Some buses go straight down to the giant building, and about every other one takes one of these curving exits. The outermost lanes, and there are only three on each side, are for cars, which this city treats as the unwanted stepchild. All the other forms of transportation stop and let people unload in the big building but the cars have to drive through and get off the thruway into the crowded city streets and park in a garage that can be blocks away and either walk to the ground floor entrances or take a local shuttle. The building is a huge hub of the city and my head calls it City Hall so I guess that’s the central location of all the government functions. I usually have this Birds Eye view of observing the city and don’t really interact with it. I know it goes on far beyond the City Hall and looks vaguely like New York City with a gigantic park in the middle, but I don’t go there in my dreams. I spend all my time between the city hall and the harbor and usually I have a vague sense that I’m supposed to be going to someplace in either City Hall or the tall buildings by the harbor but instead I’m just floating above the city and observing it (all my dreams have a common theme of something I’m supposed to be doing or a place I need to be but I’m distracted so this is pretty usual). Another interesting thing is that the city is sort of height stratified by classes. The 5-6 stories below the thruway level are dark and crowded and it’s where the poor and lower working class live. There are taller buildings sprinkled around and those are where the wealthier workers and middle class live. Like Nyc, part of my vague sense of the area beyond City Hall is that the park is lined with very expensive housing where the wealthy people live. By the harbor are four enormous round towers that are centers of commerce. I think they are my city’s version of the World Trade Center based on their function and location, and also because one of the few dreams I had with other people in it was being at those buildings helping people evacuate after some kind of 9/11 like attack. Two of the four buildings were expected to collapse so it was urgent. However in subsequent dreams the buildings are intact and there is no sign of an attack. There is big shipping and ferrries in the harbor area but it peters out pretty quickly to the kind of marinas and marshes that I grew up around in South Jersey, and if I leave the harbor and go to my left, the landscape begins looking like the shore area of south Jersey, particularly the causeway into Margate and the sparsely populated Longport of the pre casino era where my grandparents lived in real life. I have dreams in this location several times a month and I rarely remember most of my dreams so maybe I’m there more often. In the dreams I remember, I recognize that I’m dreaming and back in “my” city and I always turn and check out the thruway and City Hall to confirm it. I think next time I am there and recognize that I am, I will try to take control and navigate and see if there is a mall around anywhere.
